title: Sakura Taisen: Jouki Radio Show
native_title: サクラ大戦 ～蒸気ラジヲショウ～
overview: Sakura Taisen: Jouki Radio Show is a multimedia fan disc and newsletter for the Sakura Wars series. It contains video and photos of Sakura Wars events and shows, cast interviews, a music selection, and several mini-games. The main game feature is Feeling Couple, a short visual novel-style story in which the player invites one of the six girls on a date. There is also a selection of other small mini-games each centered around one of the characters, such as an indoor curling game with Sakura, a karate chop game with Kanna, and a robot-building game with Kohran.
